columns.name: num_orders
columns.description: Number of orders placed by the customer, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_cost_of_orders
columns.description: Average cost of orders placed by the customer.

columns.name: top_shipper
columns.description: The shipper with the highest number of orders for a customer, with ties resolved in ascending alphabetical order of the shipper's name.

columns.name: total_quantity_of_products
columns.description: Total quantity of products ordered by the customer, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_bought_product_from_France
columns.description: Set to 1 if the customer has bought at least one product from France, 0 otherwise.
